hebrewText: וְ/חָצִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת הַ/מַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים לַ/צָּבָ֑א וּ/בֵ֖ין כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה

tokens.bdb: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.kjv: divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cut or split in two; to halve

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively, spoil (and captives) (as taken)
between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
tokens.kjv: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
tokens.explanation: ben — entre, no meio de, no espaço que separa

tokens.bdb: to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably
tokens.kjv: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.

tokens.bdb: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.
tokens.explanation: yatsa — sair, partir, nascer, brotar, emergir

tokens.bdb: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
tokens.kjv: appointed time, ([phrase]) army, ([phrase]) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
tokens.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713 (עֵדָה).
